answer: Locate identities by latency. Several beacon nodes in different regions ping each agent with unpredictable challenges, and the round-trip times form a fingerprint of where it really runs. Signals can't beat the speed of light, so a farmer who tries to forge a thousand agents from one rack produces a thousand near-identical fingerprints; the ledger groups them and they split a single reward. Spreading clones across real distant machines costs about as much as running honest agents, pushing a sybil farm off the profit ledge.
